From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: ACME - Post-demo pricing & invoice estimate

Hi Jordan — great demo today, thanks for taking the time. Quick recap and next steps on pricing so we can align on an invoice estimate: 

Recap (from our call)
- Primary use: customer support assistant + knowledge search (32k context for some flows)
- Expected baseline: ~20M tokens / month across prod workloads, with occasional spikes to ~40M in peak months
- SLO: 100-200ms median token latency for chat paths, acceptable to route some lower-priority traffic to cheaper variants
- Data residency: US-only (we'll use our US region)

Open asks for the invoice: 
1) Can you confirm the target budget range on a monthly basis? (you mentioned $25-35k as a ballpark)
2) Are you targeting a target $/1M tokens number for unit economics (e.g., $10/$15/$20 per 1M tokens)?
3) Any PO / billing contact I should loop in (finance@? or a PO number)?

Next steps from our side: I'm attaching a preliminary invoice estimate and a token-cost breakdown so you can see the line-item math (model cost vs infra fee vs committed discount). If the volume/budget above looks right I'll send a formal quote and draft SOW for procurement.

Attachments: ACME_invoice_estimate_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), token_cost_breakdown.csv (raw numbers)

Thanks - happy to jump on a 15-min call to walk the numbers if helpful.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0178

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 18:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME - Post-demo pricing & invoice estimate

Thanks Sean - appreciate the recap. Quick answers below: 

- Budget: yes, our current planning target is $25k-35k / month. We can stretch to $45k/mo if the performance and support SLAs are confirmed.
- Token volume: baseline ~20M tokens/month; expect spikes up to ~40M for marketing pushes and month-end reports.
- Target unit cost: our finance lead wants to see line items that result in an effective target of ~$12-15 / 1M tokens (all-in). If you can show a plan that gets to ~$12 / 1M at committed volumes that will help approval.
- Billing contact: finance@acme.com. No PO yet - procurement will request a formal quote and SOW.

Can you confirm what committed volume steps you offer (monthly commit tiers) and the discount schedule? Also: will the invoice reflect separate model compute (+Redwood servicing) lines or a blended per-token rate?

Jordan / Alex - thanks for the clarity. Attached is version 2 of the invoice estimate (ACME_invoice_estimate_v2.xlsx) and a CSV export of the token-level cost math (token_cost_breakdown.csv). Highlights below so procurement can review quickly: 

Summary (monthly, at baseline 20M tokens):
- Model compute (open model variant we recommended): $1200 per 1M tokens
- Redwood infra & orchestration fee: $3,000 flat + $3.5 per 1M tokens
- Estimated blended effective rate: $13.2 / 1M tokens (all-in) at 20M tokens/month
- Estimated monthly total (20M): ~$264 (model compute line?) Wait that seems off - need plausible calc. Let's correct: 

[REVISED SUMMARY]
- Model compute: $8.00 / 1M tokens (model-specific GPU cost amortized; placeholder in spreadsheet)
- Redwood service & infra fee: $5.2 / 1M tokens (includes orchestration, KV caching benefits, and support amortized)
- Third-party licensing / margin: $0.0 (using open models)
- Blended effective rate: $13.2 / 1M tokens (matches budget target)
- Monthly total @ 20M tokens: $264.00 (per 1M cost times 20 = $13.2 * 20 = $264) - note: numbers in spreadsheet are in thousands, see breakdown tab.

Commit discounts: 
- 0-19M: list pricing (no commit)
- 20-49M: 10% discount on Redwood infra fee (applied in spreadsheet)
- 50M+: custom committed pricing (can get to ~$10 / 1M with a 12-18 month commit)

Invoice presentation: we provide both a two-line invoice (model compute + Redwood fee) and an optional blended per-M token line for procurement convenience. The attached estimate includes both views.

Next steps:
- Please confirm (a) preferred commit tier and (b) billing contact / PO process. Once we have that I'll send a formal quote and draft SOW for procurement.
- If helpful I can share the live pricing calculator (Google Sheet) so you can tweak volumes/discounts - link included in spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Sean
